Blindspot.description: Browser-based arena combat card RPG — no download, no install. Players build a fighter card, battle through a 10-boss campaign, then enter async PvP
features: async PvP with Elo ranking and defense queue
card progression with border evolution and title milestones
loot crates, cosmetics, battle charms, consumable items
Forge for card customization (stats, look, details)
Sparks economy (earn from battles, spend in shop)
per-card battle history with nemesis tracking
notThis: it is NOT a trading card game — no card marketplace or trading
it is NOT CardForge — Blindspot is a standalone game, fully decoupled
it does NOT require download or install — 100% browser-based
it does NOT use real money for gameplay — Sparks are earned in-game
cards are NOT randomly generated — players build them in Quick Build or Forge
it is NOT turn-based strategy — it's real-time move selection with rock-paper-scissors combat
